d: A square in Genoa. At the bottom of the church of San Lorenzo. To the right the palace of the Fieschi with large balcony: in the wall next to the balcony is an image, in front of which burns a lantern: to the left other houses. Various roads lead to the square. It is night. Paolo and Peter on stage, continuing a speech.
Paolo solo.
Said and Simone coming in hasty.
Paolo, Pietro, Marinai, Artisans.
Fiesco leaves the building.
Said and Simone returning to the thrilling scene.
Said, Paolo, Pietro, Marinai, People of both sexes, with torches lit.
Giardino de' Grimaldi outside Genoa. On the left the palace; facing the sea. Aurora. Amelia (observing the horizon).
Detta and Gabriel from the right.
Said, an Ancella, then Pietro.
Gabriele and Amelia.
Gabriel goes out of the right and meets Andrea.
Doge, Paolo and Séguito, then Amelia from the palace.
Amelia and the Doge.
Doge and Paul from the right.
Paul and Peter from the right hand

Council Hall in the Palace of the Abbots. The Doge sitting on the ducal seat; on the one hand, twelve noble Councillors; on the other hand, twelve People's Councillors. Sitting separately, four Consuls of the Sea and the Connestables. Paolo and Peter stand on the last seats of the people. An Herald.

It breaks the crowd of the People, the Councillors, etc., etc., many Women, some Children, the Doge, Paul, Peter. The noble Councilors always divided by the People. Adorno and Fiesco grabbed by the People.
Amelia and sayings.
Doge's Room in the Doge's Palace in Genoa. Side doors. From a poggiolo you can see the city. A table: an amphora and a cup. ~ Annotta. Paolo and Pietro.
Paolo.
That said, Fiesco and Gabriel from the right, led by Peter, who withdraws.
Paul and Gabriel.
Gabriele alone.
Said and Amelia from the left.
Detta and the Doge, who enters from the right reading a sheet.
The Doge and Gabriel hidden.
Dettali and Amelia

Interior of the Doge's Palace. Of great openings from which Genoa will be seen illuminated at festival: at the bottom of the sea. A captain of crossbows, with Fiesco, from the right, then from the left Paolo in the middle of the Guards.
I'm lonely.
The Doge: the Captain precedes him with a tromboneter, Fiesco in the background.
Dettali, Maria, Gabriel, Senatori, Dame, Gentiluomini, Paggi con torce, etc., etc.
